settings.heading: Types of Rugs Explained: How to Choose the Right Material and Shape for Every Room

settings.text:
The selection of your floor foundation requires knowledge about different rug types and their respective performance characteristics. The different varieties provide various ways to maintain durability while achieving
visual appeal and maintaining different surface textures.

1. Area Rugs: The Foundation of Every Room Area rugs are the most popular choice for interior spaces because they provide coverage to specific areas of the floor while leaving other areas uncovered.

Best For: Living rooms, primary bedrooms, and large dining areas.

Key Use: The main purpose of these items is to function as "anchors" for furniture placement. The arrangement of an 8x10 area rug under your sofa and coffee table in a large living room creates a structured "island" which makes the room appear more organized.

2. Jute Rugs:
Sustainable Texture The jute rug made from "Golden Fiber" serves as
an eco-friendly natural flooring material which delivers a home with authentic
rustic charm. Best For: Sunrooms, home offices, and layered decor. Key Use: The
flooring material works well for areas with heavy foot traffic because of its
strong design and natural earth tones. Designers use these materials as a "base
layer" which allows them to create depth and texture by placing smaller colourful
patterned rugs on top of bigger jute rugs.

3. Round Rugs:
Breaking the Lines Round rugs create soft curves that provide an alternative
design option to rectangular furniture while breaking up the "boxy"
appearance of a room. Best For: Entryways, circular dining tables, and
children's play areas. Key Use: A round rug is excellent for making a small
space appear larger. The design creates an inward visual path which works effectively
under a swivel chair or in a tight reading space where a standard rectangular
rug would take up too much room.

4. Washable Rugs:
High-Performance Convenience The 2026 major trend for washable rugs features a low-pile design with special backing material that enables home washing machine cleaning.

Rugs create their first visual attraction when
they enter a room but they deliver multiple important home benefits which
extend beyond their initial appearance. The decorative benefits of hand-woven
jute rugs and area rugs increase when you use them to cover your floors.
